fragment BindingConnectorDeclaration returns SysML::BindingConnector :
	  FeatureDeclaration
	  ( 'of' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember 
	    '=' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember )?
	| ( isSufficient ?= 'all' )?
	  ( 'of'? ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember 
	    '=' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember )?
;
